chunks: From him, from al-‘Abbās, from ‘Alī ibn Ismā‘īl, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥakīm, who said: al-Mīthamī—I only know that he said:
I saw Abā ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام, or one who saw him, unclothed while there was a cloth over his private part, and he said: “Indeed, the thigh is not part of the ‘awrah.”

key_terms.الْعَوْرَةِ: the legally private area requiring concealment
key_terms.عَوْرَتِهِ: his private part that must be covered

ai.seo_question: Is the thigh considered part of the ‘awrah in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam Abū ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام stated that the thigh is not included in the ‘awrah. It appears in the context of the etiquette and rulings related to entering the bathhouse and addresses the legal boundary of what must be covered.
